headline: Visualizing European Bird Migration in Real Time
lede: The EuroBirdPortal project harmonizes diverse citizen-science observations into a unified, pan-European view of avian movement. It offers researchers a dynamic look at how climate and habitat influence migration patterns across the continent.

headline: AI Deciphers a 370-Year-Old Royalist Prayer
lede: A modern AI model has finally cracked the Cyphral Distich, a complex cryptogram that baffled scholars for centuries. By recognizing hidden indexing patterns within the original text, the machine successfully reconstructed a long-lost historical document.

headline: Emulating a 386 PC on Modern Microcontrollers
lede: The FRANK 386 project brings legacy x86 computing to the Raspberry Pi Pico 2. This firmware allows enthusiasts to run classic DOS and Windows environments on compact, affordable hardware.

headline: Playing the Asteroid in a Reverse Arcade Challenge
lede: Spaceships flips the classic arcade dynamic, casting the player as the asteroid navigating through incoming fire. This browser-based project delivers a nostalgic, high-fidelity experience built entirely on modern web technologies.

headline: Signal Implements Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Phone-Free Identity
lede: Signal is evolving its infrastructure to move away from telephone-number requirements by leveraging advanced zero-knowledge proofs. This shift aims to minimize server-side data collection and decouple user identity from personal contact information.

headline: Mapping Periodic Solutions in the Three-Body Problem
lede: The three-body problem has long eluded general analytical solutions due to its inherent chaotic nature. This new interactive atlas catalogs nearly four thousand stable, periodic orbital configurations to aid in gravitational research.

headline: Readable PyTorch Implementations for Modern LLMs
lede: OpenArch provides hand-written, clean-room PyTorch code for state-of-the-art model architectures. These implementations strip away production-level performance hacks to prioritize educational clarity and structural comprehension.

headline: Apple Publishes Official Dimensional Specifications for Accessory Designers
lede: Apple has released a comprehensive repository of technical drawings and CAD files for its hardware lineup. This official resource ensures that peripheral manufacturers maintain precise tolerances and perfect fits for modern devices.

headline: Is JPEG XL Necessary for the Modern Web?
lede: Critics argue that JPEG XL adds unnecessary engineering complexity to the web stack without offering a compelling advantage over existing standards like AVIF. The debate highlights the tension between supporting niche professional needs and maintaining baseline web performance.
pullquote: Adding new formats for the sake of developer choice often ignores the heavy cost of browser fragmentation and long-term maintenance.

headline: Actual Viewport Heights Fall Short of 1080p Standards
lede: Browser chrome, taskbars, and tabs routinely consume significant screen real estate, reducing the actual usable height for web content. New data suggests designers should account for a 920-pixel limit when targeting standard desktop setups.
